rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a thorough understanding of something.

example.english: I have a thorough comprehension of the whole matter now.
example.traditional: 我對成件事已經有充分理解喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 seng4 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 jau5 cung1 fan6 lei5 gaai2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for comprehension of written passages, especially in school or test contexts.

example.english: This Chinese reading comprehension isn't too difficult.
example.traditional: 今次中文科嘅閱讀理解唔算難。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zung1 man4 fo1 ge3 jyut6 duk6 lei5 gaai2 m4 syun3 naan4
